description: This file defines data structures, types, and inline functions related to cache bins used in jemalloc's internal memory management, specifically for handling cache bin statistics, information, and allocation routines.

methods.name: cache_bin_array_descriptor_init
methods.description: Initializes a cache_bin_array_descriptor_t structure with given small and large bin pointers.

methods.name: cache_bin_alloc_easy
methods.description: Allocates an object from a cache_bin_t, updating success status and low_water mark.
